description: The bar chart illustrates the sample count of essays categorized by genre, comparing Open-Ended sets (Open) and Constrained sets (Cons.). The horizontal axis represents the essay genres, which include Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository. The vertical axis indicates the sample count, with values ranging from 0 to 130. For the Argumentative genre, the Open set has a sample count of 79, while the Cons. set has a higher count of 122. In the Narrative genre, the Open set is slightly higher with a count of 80 compared to the Cons. set at 87. The Descriptive genre shows a lower count for the Open set at 68, with the Cons. set at 100. Lastly, the Expository genre has the lowest count for the Open set at 62, but the highest count for the Cons. set at 130. The bars are color-coded, with the Open set represented in blue and the Cons. set in pink. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
